understanding: Count customers per employee, listing all employees with 0 for those with no customers.
expected: Andrew Adams 0; Nancy Edwards 1; Jane Peacock 2
got: Andrew Adams 1; Nancy Edwards 1; Jane Peacock 2
reason: COUNT(*) after LEFT JOIN counts the NULL-extended row as 1, so employees with no customers show 1 instead of 0.

understanding: List each employee with the direct manager's full name, NULL if none.
edge_cases: two employees reporting to same manager
expected: Andrew Adams/NULL; Nancy Edwards/Andrew Adams; Jane Peacock/Nancy Edwards; Steve Park/Nancy Edwards
reason: Self LEFT JOIN keeps employees without a manager and returns the right manager names.

understanding: 2023 invoice total per support-rep employee through their customers, with name and revenue.
reason: Half-open date range handles the end-of-year timestamp correctly and sums are not duplicated.

understanding: For each media type, count distinct tracks sold at least once.
edge_cases: track sold in two invoices (distinct count)
media type with no sold tracks
two tracks of one type sold
reason: COUNT(DISTINCT) avoids duplicate counting; only ambiguity is whether media types with zero sold tracks should appear as 0.

understanding: Count albums with total duration over 1 hour and at least one track with empty Composer.
edge_cases: album exactly 3,600,000 ms with NULL composer (excluded)
album over 1h with a NULL composer
reason: Strict > threshold, NULL-composer detection and NULL album exclusion all behave correctly.

understanding: Total invoice revenue for Q1 2025 (Jan 1 to Mar 31 inclusive).
reason: InvoiceDate <= '2025-03-31' drops all invoices on March 31 since the datetime strings compare greater than the date string.

understanding: Count customers who bought at least one Rock track and at least one Jazz track.
edge_cases: customer with both genres in one invoice
customer with both genres in separate invoices
reason: HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.Name) >= 1 only requires one of the two genres (should be = 2), so customers with only Rock or Jazz are counted.

understanding: Monthly revenue for 2025 ordered by month.
reason: Half-open range, grouping and zero-padded month ordering are right.

understanding: Top 3 artists by line revenue from German customers in 2024, descending.
reason: Filters, quantity multiplication, grouping and ordering/limit all match the hand calculation.

understanding: Countries having at least 5 customers, with customer counts.
reason: >= 5 boundary and NULL-country handling are right.
